'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[2025 Gaza Strip aid distribution incidents]]
***Thirty-six [[Palestinians]] are killed by [[Israel]]i gunfire while trying to obtain [[humanitarian aid|aid]] in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-hamas-war-news-hostages-aid-06-10-2025-fe6c6c36e302ee1766f1b0f2a7d5bc19 (AP)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Kyiv strikes (2022–present)|Kyiv strikes]], [[Odesa strikes (2022–present)|Odesa strikes]]
***[[Russian Armed Forces|Russia]] launches [[drone attack]]s on [[Kyiv]] and [[Odesa]], [[Ukraine]]. In Odesa, drone attacks hit [[medical facilities]] and residential buildings, killing two people and injuring thirteen others. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cx2jzp0ewe0o (BBC News)]
*[[Colombian conflict]]
**Seven people are killed, including two [[National Police of Colombia|police officers]], and 36 others are injured in nineteen bombings and shootings by [[FARC dissidents]] targeting police posts, municipal buildings and civilians in [[Cali]], [[Valle del Cauca]], [[Colombia]]. Another explosion is also reported in [[Jamundí]]. '''Business and economy'''
*[[Fossil fuel phase-out]]
**The [[Government of the United Kingdom|British government]] announces it will invest {{GBP}}14.2 billion (US$19 billion) to construct the new [[Sizewell C nuclear power station|Sizewell C]] [[nuclear power station]] in [[Suffolk]], [[England]], to reduce the country's reliance on [[fossil fuel]]s. [https://apnews.com/article/uk-britain-nuclear-plant-suffolk-investment-27e13197344cf96b5b76c4503e5a8b9e (AP)] [https://www.reuters.com/sustainability/boards-policy-regulation/britain-invest-142-billion-pounds-sizewell-c-nuclear-project-2025-06-09/ (Reuters)]
*[[The Walt Disney Company]] closes a deal to acquire [[NBCUniversal]]'s stake in the [[streaming service]] [[Hulu]] for $439 million, completing its [[merger and acquisition|acquisition]] of Hulu. [https://apnews.com/article/disney-hulu-comcast-nbcuniversal-iger-876a9d6f00ffa6c037e9527bb8532682 (AP)] [https://variety.com/2025/tv/news/disney-closes-hulu-deal-comcast-price-tag-1236423903/ (''Variety'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Protests against Donald Trump]]
**[[June 2025 Los Angeles protests]]
***[[Mayor of Los Angeles|Los Angeles mayor]] [[Karen Bass]] imposes a curfew to the [[Downtown Los Angeles]] area in [[California]], [[United States]], after several days of [[civil disobedience]] and [[protests|public demonstrations]] against [[Immigrations and Customs Enforcement]] agents detaining [[Demographics of Los Angeles|locals]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/la-protests-live-downtown-la-declared-unlawful-assembly-area-after-third-day-2025-06-09/ (Reuters)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/6/11/la-mayor-announces-curfew-amid-protests-over-trumps-immigration-crackdown (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2025 Ballymena riots]]
**The second consecutive night of disorder in [[Ballymena]], [[Northern Ireland]], sees 17 [[Police Service of Northern Ireland|police officers]] injured and five people arrested as protests spread to [[Belfast]], [[Carrickfergus]], and [[Newtownabbey]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c0k3le25r8ro (BBC News)]
*[[Graz school shooting]]
**Eleven people are killed, including the perpetrator, and several others are injured, in a [[Mass shooting|mass]] [[School shooting|shooting]] at a [[secondary school]] in [[Graz]], [[Austria]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/live/ce3vxrz6rpnt (BBC News)]
*[[Capital punishment in Iran]] 
**[[Iran]] [[Hanging|hangs]] nine members of the [[Islamic State]] for a 2018 attack which killed three [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps]] personnel. [https://apnews.com/article/iran-executions-islamic-state-group-militants-2018-attack-7a86932a41dc3d321c69840e2e17e878 (AP)]
*The [[Federal Police of Brazil|Federal Police]] of [[Brazil]] arrest at least eleven people in an operation aiming to reduce [[drug trafficking]] in [[favela]]s in [[Rio de Janeiro]]. [https://apnews.com/article/brazil-police-arrest-drugs-gangs-favela-61406e8418a7028f816ce7dfcd3b22ea (AP)]
*The [[Supreme Court of Argentina]] ratifies the sentence of former [[President of Argentina|president]] [[Cristina Fernández de Kirchner]] to six years in prison and a lifetime disqualification from holding [[public office]] for the crime of [[fraud]]ulent administration. [https://www.lanacion.com.ar/politica/la-corte-suprema-confirmo-la-condena-a-cristina-kirchner-a-prision-y-no-podra-ser-candidata-nid10062025/ (''La Nación'')]
